newsitem.title: USA: Mutual fund assets rose in latest week - ICI.
newsitem.headline: Mutual fund assets rose in latest week - ICI.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended Thursday rose to $1.01 trillion from a revised $990.14 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 675 retail money market mutual funds rose $9.59 billion to $667.59 billion in the week.

Of the retail funds, assets of the 403 taxable money market funds rose $6.52 billion to $546.25 billion, while assets of the 272 tax-exempt funds rose $3.07 billion to $121.34 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 328 institutional money market funds rose $9.29 billion to $341.43 billion. Of these, assets of the 265 taxable money market funds rose $7.70 billion to $304.74 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds grew $1.60 billion to $36.70 billion, it said.
ICI revised total money market mutual fund assets for the previous week to $990.14 billion from $986.17 billion.
